question: Does the customer explicitly request a refund or their money back?
workflow: Customer support inbox: route each incoming message to the refunds queue or the general queue.
acceptance: Ship if Jev matches expected on at least 38 of 40 cases and agrees with the model on at least 36.

choices.name: yes
choices.definition: yes: Explicit request to return their payment, including refund or money back.

choices.name: no
choices.definition: no: No explicit request for money back. Questions about hours or exchanges alone are no.
